subject.title: TodoMVC (React): how the todo list works
subject.intent: Explain how the React TodoMVC adds, edits, completes, filters and clears todos, and where it departs from the TodoMVC spec

Todo.desc: One todo: a random id, the trimmed title and whether it is done. The spec asks for exactly these keys in localStorage.

Action.desc: What a component asks the store to do. Every change to the list goes through one of these seven actions.

Route.desc: The filter in the URL hash: #/ shows all, #/active the open todos, #/completed the done ones. Survives a reload because it is in the URL.

TextInput.label: Text input
TextInput.desc: The one text field used twice: to type a new todo in the header and to edit a todo in place.
logic: On Enter it trims the text and submits it.
As the new-todo field it ignores an empty submit and clears itself after submitting.
As the edit field it submits even an empty title (the item deletes the todo) and also submits on blur.
Any other key, Escape included, does nothing.

nodes.label: Trim
nodes.desc: Removes spaces at both ends of what was typed.
nodes.logic: value = text.trim(); a title of only spaces becomes empty.

nodes.label: Enter?
nodes.desc: Only Enter submits.
logic: Enter: yes, carry the trimmed value on.
Any other key, Escape included: no, nothing happens.

nodes.label: Empty new todo?
nodes.desc: Lets the edit field submit an empty title but stops the new-todo field from adding one.
logic: Edit field: always submit; an empty title tells the item to delete the todo.
New-todo field with an empty value: ignore.
New-todo field with a value: submit, then clear the field.

nodes.label: Type a todo, press Enter
nodes.desc: The user writes a new todo in the big field at the top.

context.from: Header › What needs to be done?

nodes.label: Pick a filter
nodes.desc: The user clicks All, Active or Completed, or opens a URL with that hash.

nodes.label: Header
nodes.desc: The title and the field where new todos are typed.

nodes.label: New todo field
nodes.desc: The text input in new-todo mode (editing = false): empty submits are ignored and the field clears after each todo.

nodes.label: Add item
nodes.desc: Asks the store to add a todo with the submitted title.

nodes.label: Hash router
nodes.desc: react-router's HashRouter: turns the URL hash into a route every component can read with useLocation.

nodes.label: Todo store
nodes.desc: The list of todos and the one reducer that changes it. Every component sends actions here.

nodes.label: todos
nodes.desc: Every todo, in the order they were added.
nodes.store: useReducer in App · in memory, lost on reload

nodes.label: Make an id
nodes.desc: Gives each new todo a random id.
logic: 21 characters picked with Math.random from a 64-letter alphabet (a copy of nanoid's non-secure version).
Unique enough for a local list; not meant for security.

nodes.label: Apply action
nodes.desc: Builds the next list from the current one and an action, without changing the old list.
logic: ADD_ITEM appends { id, title, completed: false }; UPDATE_ITEM renames one todo; REMOVE_ITEM drops it.
TOGGLE_ITEM flips one todo; TOGGLE_ALL sets every todo to the given state.
REMOVE_COMPLETED_ITEMS keeps the open todos; REMOVE_ALL_ITEMS empties the list.
An unknown action type throws an error.

nodes.label: Todo list
nodes.desc: The filtered list, one row per todo, and the Mark all as complete checkbox. Hidden while there are no todos.

nodes.label: Filter by route
nodes.desc: Picks the todos the current route shows.
logic: /active keeps the todos not completed; /completed keeps the completed ones.
Any other route shows them all.
Recomputed when the list or the route changes, so a todo checked under Active disappears at once.

nodes.label: All shown are done?
nodes.desc: Decides whether Mark all as complete appears checked.
logic: Checked when at least one todo is shown and every shown todo is completed.
It looks only at the shown (filtered) todos.

nodes.label: Click Mark all as complete
nodes.desc: The user clicks the chevron left of the new-todo field.

nodes.label: Toggle all
nodes.desc: Asks the store to set every todo to the checkbox's new state.
nodes.logic: Dispatches { type: TOGGLE_ALL, payload: { completed: checked } }, which applies to all todos, shown or not.

nodes.label: Mark all checkbox
nodes.desc: The chevron, dark when every shown todo is done.

nodes.label: Todo item
nodes.desc: One row: checkbox, title, delete button, and an edit field that replaces the row on double-click. Rendered once per shown todo.

nodes.label: Click the checkbox
nodes.desc: The user marks the todo done or open again.

nodes.label: Click ×
nodes.desc: The user deletes the todo with the cross that shows on hover.

nodes.label: Double-click the title
nodes.desc: The user starts editing the todo's title.

nodes.label: Type in the edit field
nodes.desc: The user changes the title and presses a key or clicks away.

nodes.label: Toggle item
nodes.desc: Asks the store to flip this todo between done and open.

nodes.label: Start editing
nodes.desc: Swaps the row for the edit field, filled with the current title and focused.
nodes.logic: Sets isWritable to true; the row gets the editing class and the Input mounts with autoFocus.

nodes.label: isWritable
nodes.desc: Whether this row is in edit mode. Each row has its own, so only the double-clicked one changes.
nodes.store: useState in Item · lost on reload

nodes.label: Edit field
nodes.desc: The text input in edit mode (editing = true): Enter and blur both submit, and an empty title is passed on.

nodes.label: Commit edit
nodes.desc: Ends the edit once and either renames or deletes the todo.
logic: Not in edit mode any more (Enter already committed, then blur fired): ignore.
Leaves edit mode.
Empty title: delete the todo.
Otherwise: rename it.

nodes.label: Update item
nodes.desc: Asks the store to rename this todo.
nodes.logic: Dispatches { type: UPDATE_ITEM, payload: { id, title } }.

nodes.label: Remove item
nodes.desc: Asks the store to delete this todo.
nodes.logic: Dispatches { type: REMOVE_ITEM, payload: { id } }. Used by the × button and by an edit that leaves the title empty.

nodes.label: Todo row
nodes.desc: The title, struck through when completed, or the edit field while editing.

nodes.label: Shown todos
nodes.desc: The rows for the current filter, one Todo item each.

nodes.label: Footer
nodes.desc: The counter, the filter links and Clear completed. Hidden while there are no todos.

nodes.label: Count todos
nodes.desc: Counts the open and the completed todos, over the whole list, whatever the filter.
logic: Open: the todos not completed.
Completed: all todos minus the open ones.

nodes.label: Items left
nodes.desc: "1 item left!" or "N items left!", with the plural handled.

nodes.label: Filter links
nodes.desc: All, Active and Completed; the one matching the route is outlined.

nodes.label: Click Clear completed
nodes.desc: The user removes every completed todo at once.

nodes.label: Remove completed
nodes.desc: Asks the store to drop every completed todo.

nodes.label: Clear completed button
nodes.desc: Shown only while at least one todo is completed.

risks.title: Todos are lost on reload
risks.detail: The TodoMVC spec asks every app to persist the todos to localStorage under todos-react. Here the list lives only in useReducer, starting from an empty array, so a reload empties it. The filter survives (it is in the URL), the todos don't.
risks.resolution: Initialise useReducer from localStorage['todos-react'] and write the list back in an effect whenever it changes; leave edit mode out of it.

risks.title: Escape doesn't cancel an edit
risks.detail: The spec says Escape leaves edit mode and discards the changes. The text input only reacts to Enter, so Escape does nothing: the edit field stays open, and the next click away saves whatever was typed.
risks.resolution: Handle Escape in the edit field: leave edit mode without dispatching, so the title stays as it was.

risks.title: Mark all reads the shown todos but changes all of them
risks.detail: The checkbox's state comes from the filtered todos, while TOGGLE_ALL applies to the whole list. Under Completed with nothing completed yet, the box is unchecked and the list is empty; one click completes every open todo, which then appear.
risks.resolution: Compute the checkbox from the whole list, or make TOGGLE_ALL act only on the shown todos; the spec describes the whole list.

risks.title: REMOVE_ALL_ITEMS is never sent
risks.detail: The reducer handles REMOVE_ALL_ITEMS, but no component dispatches it: dead code that a reader may take for a feature.
risks.resolution: Remove the action and its constant, or wire it to a control if it was meant to be one.
